Item 3. Key Information

Acme serves industrial customers through distributors in several countries, and its operating results depend on customer demand, product availability, and the timing of large orders.

During 2023, the company expanded its service organization and continued investing in product reliability, supplier qualification, cybersecurity controls, and employee training.

Management monitors liquidity, foreign exchange exposure, contractual commitments, and market conditions when allocating capital to operations and long-term projects.
